items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And they were working for, for Mike Fritzl and who did it.

ctx.x: He's the, shrine? Yeah. There's a picture of the same band in the, in his office. Oh, that's a lot of them. He, cause he got it from a cousin of mine that, uh, they played for a, a carnival organization over the river called the Big 50s. Uh huh. And, uh, they used to go out, you know, with black, all blackface, and they always had Fisher's band. And that, they, he, he, he's got it, cause I saw it up on the wall there and I asked Mike where he got it. And he tell you he got it from my cousin.
Was your cousin the music? No.
